maria: FYI opened a docs PR to consolidate the private / VPC / on‑prem install flow, add a small network diagram, and include a short Go + Python SDK connection example. PLZ check KMS/HSM wording and port matrix. PR: https://github.com/redwood/docs/pull/1234

ravi: Quick skim — looks sensible. Two asks: mention PKCS#11 socket path for the HSM plugin, and add a systemd unit example for the kms-proxy service so ops knows how to run it on boot.

olivia: I can add the diagram (SVG) and regenerate the port matrix table. Will also run linkcheck locally before pushing.

bryan: Minor nit in the Go snippet: we should show TLS config + env variable example for KMS endpoint. Current example uses InsecureSkipVerify true which we shouldn't encourage. Suggest replacing with this small snippet:```go
// example TLS setup for KMS client
creds := credentials.NewTLS(&tls.Config{InsecureSkipVerify: false})
conn, err := grpc.Dial(os.Getenv("KMS_ENDPOINT"), grpc.WithTransportCredentials(creds))
if err != nil { log.Fatal(err) }
```
Also add an env example: `export KMS_ENDPOINT=unix:///var/run/hsm/socket` (or `tls://kms.example:443`).

maria: Good call. Ravi — can you paste the systemd override example? Olivia — after you add the SVG, can you ensure the SVG is added under assets/diagrams and referenced with the correct relative path? We want the docs build to pick it up without additional bundling.

ravi: Systemd override I usually share:```ini
[Unit]
Description=redwood kms-proxy
After=network.target

[Service]
ExecStart=/usr/local/bin/kms-proxy --config /etc/redwood/kms-proxy.yaml
Restart=on-failure
User=kms
LimitNOFILE=65536

[Install]
WantedBy=multi-user.target
```
Add a note about SELinux label and file permissions if running on RHEL/CentOS.

docs-bot: docs-lint check: link-check passed, spelling: 1 warning ("priviledged" -> "privileged"), broken-anchor: 0. CI preview URL: https://deploy-preview-1234--docs.redwood.ai/priv-vpc-install

olivia: pushed diagram commit, updated port matrix, fixed the spelling warning. I moved the PKCS#11 path example into the KMS section and added an inline note: "HSM sockets often live at /var/run/hsm/pkcs11.sock; update permissions to allow the kms-proxy user." Ran `make linkcheck` locally.

bryan: ACK on the TLS sample. One more tiny thing: in the Python SDK example, show usage of the `pathlib.Path` for unix socket endpoints to avoid accidental URL parsing errors.

maria: Thanks all — if no objections I'll merge once we have one more approval. @bryan can you give a quick signoff on the Go/Python snippets? @ravi can you add the SELinux note as a followup commit if needed.

bryan: 👍 lgtm for the snippets after the InsecureSkipVerify change.

ravi: I'll add the SELinux snippet in a followup and ping for review.

maria: Merging in ~15m unless anyone flags anything. Thanks everyone :rocket:
